name: Organ Orbs gives Pooled Vitality 3% Spirit per stack (#605)
contract: Organ Orbs 807490 is one effect: aura 107 with MiscValue 23 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT3, which Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers maps to effect index 2) and BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = +3, over EffectSpellClassMask (536870912, 0, 0) = word 0 bit 29 = Pooled Vitality 680687 and Running Wild 800175. Pooled Vitality's effect 2 is aura 137 MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE with MiscValue 4 (STAT_SPIRIT) and value 0, so it becomes 3, and AuraEffect::CalculateAmount multiplies by the stack amount. Running Wild's effect 2 is aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, whose amount is unread. Tooltip: "Each stack of Pooled Vitality now increases your Spirit by $s1%." Regression guard for native behaviour.
